params.baseInstructions: You translate the supplied natural-language proof faithfully into Lean 4. Use the explicit project premises and any proved result in the pinned Mathlib environment. Preserve all assumptions, conclusions, equality modes and the supplied proof route. No reference answers, personal context, other tasks, shell or external services are available. Use the submit tool when the requested artifact is complete; if rejected, repair it. A strategy is advice, never an additional theorem or assumption. End this stage immediately when a submit tool reports stage_complete:true; the controller handles later stages. Within a proof stage, checked helper attempts are available through read_lean_draft. After a context reset, query its index before claiming no draft or helper exists. Helpers never become new premises. Use familiar interfaces directly; no background-note scan is required. For a relevant obstacle, select a matching local background_note_index entry and read_background_note if its details may help. Relate the actual Lean goal/context to its NL step: use the note grounds to identify a small missing application premise or transport, prove it from permitted inputs, then check the intended application. Verify actual types and conditions; a note is not a Lean proof or extra assumption. If it does not fit, continue ordinary allowed search or repair without insisting on that note or rebuilding a larger argument by default.

dynamicTools.name: search_mathlib
dynamicTools.description: Search the pinned mathlib Lean source using a regular expression; at most 100 lines.

dynamicTools.name: read_mathlib
dynamicTools.description: Read specified lines of a Mathlib/*.lean source file from the pinned checkout.

dynamicTools.name: check_transition
dynamicTools.description: Compile a tactic body for the fixed target; no leading by, declarations, or placeholders.

dynamicTools.name: submit_transition
dynamicTools.description: Submit and check the final tactic body for the same target.

dynamicTools.name: check_auxiliary
dynamicTools.description: Compile one helper proposition and tactic body in exactly this local port context. This never accepts the final goal or adds a premise.

dynamicTools.name: read_lean_draft
dynamicTools.description: Read only your own same-stage proof/helper attempts. kind=index lists attempts; proof/auxiliary returns the selected body lines and actual check. No other stage or file is accessible.

dynamicTools.name: read_background_note
dynamicTools.description: Read one complete audited background note from this task index by its qualified ID. No other task, file or proof is accessible; this is guidance, not a checked Lean proof.

{"task": "Prove exactly this local conditional obligation using the supplied NL route. Return only the tactic body through submit_transition. All displayed parameter and input proof binders are already in context.", "packet": {"version": 2, "contract_sha256": "8ae9dc883dfbcb3b7eb394f1aaac4de567f9b55c2b7f6a07d3bf79784568524f", "header": "import Mathlib

open scoped BigOperators Topology ContDiff
open MeasureTheory

namespace WM
abbrev X (n : ℕ) := Fin n → ℝ
abbrev Y (m : ℕ) := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)
def dom (n : ℕ) : Set (X n × ℝ) := {p | 0 < p.2}
noncomputable def dt {n : ℕ} {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (f : X n × ℝ → V) (x : X n) (t : ℝ) : V := deriv (fun r => f (x,r)) t
noncomputable def dx {n : ℕ} {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (f : X n × ℝ → V) (j : Fin n) (x : X n) (t : ℝ) : V := fderiv ℝ (fun y => f (y,t)) x (Pi.single j 1)
noncomputable def ut {n m : ℕ} (u : X n × ℝ → Y m) : X n × ℝ → Y m := fun p => dt u p.1 p.2
noncomputable def utt {n m : ℕ} (u : X n × ℝ → Y m) : X n × ℝ → Y m := fun p => dt (ut u) p.1 p.2
noncomputable def xu {n m : ℕ} (u : X n × ℝ → Y m) (j : Fin n) : X n × ℝ → Y m := fun p => dx u j p.1 p.2
noncomputable def lap {n m : ℕ} (u : X n × ℝ → Y m) (x : X n) (t : ℝ) : Y m := ∑ j, dx (xu u j) j x t
noncomputable def e {n m : ℕ} (u : X n × ℝ → Y m) : X n × ℝ → ℝ := fun p => ‖ut u p‖ ^ 2 + ∑ j, ‖xu u j p‖ ^ 2
noncomputable def et {n m : ℕ} (u : X n × ℝ → Y m) : X n × ℝ → ℝ := fun p => dt (e u) p.1 p.2
noncomputable def energy {n m : ℕ} (u : X n × ℝ → Y m) (t : ℝ) : ℝ := ∫ x, e u (x,t)
def box (n : ℕ) (R : ℝ) : Set (X n) := {x | ∀ j, x j ∈ Set.Icc (-R) R}
def openBox (n : ℕ) (R : ℝ) : Set (X n) := {x | ∀ j, x j ∈ Set.Ioo (-R) R}
noncomputable def aTerm {n m : ℕ} (u : X n × ℝ → Y m) : X n × ℝ → ℝ := fun p => inner ℝ (ut u p) (utt u p)
noncomputable def bTerm {n m : ℕ} (u : X n × ℝ → Y m) (j : Fin n) : X n × ℝ → ℝ := fun p => inner ℝ (xu u j p) (dx (ut u) j p.1 p.2)
noncomputable def cTerm {n m : ℕ} (u : X n × ℝ → Y m) (j : Fin n) : X n × ℝ → ℝ := fun p => inner ℝ (ut u p) (dx (xu u j) j p.1 p.2)
noncomputable def flux {n m : ℕ} (u : X n × ℝ → Y m) (j : Fin n) : X n × ℝ → ℝ := fun p => inner ℝ (ut u p) (xu u j p)
noncomputable def divFlux {n m : ℕ} (u : X n × ℝ → Y m) (j : Fin n) : X n × ℝ → ℝ := fun p => dx (flux u j) j p.1 p.2
def regular {n m : ℕ} (u : X n × ℝ → Y m) : Prop :=
  ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (ut u) (dom n) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (utt u) (dom n) ∧ (∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (xu u j) (dom n)) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (e u) (dom n) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (et u) (dom n) ∧
  (∀ x t, 0 < t → et u (x,t) = 2 * aTerm u (x,t) + 2 * ∑ j, bTerm u j (x,t)) ∧
  (∀ j x t, 0 < t → dt (xu u j) x t = dx (ut u) j x t)
def good {n : ℕ} (C : Set (X n)) (R : ℝ) (f : X n → ℝ) : Prop :=
  Continuous f ∧ (∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧ ∀ x ∈ box n R, |f x| ≤ B) ∧ (∀ x, x ∉ C → f x = 0) ∧ Integrable f
noncomputable def quot {n m : ℕ} (u : X n × ℝ → Y m) (t h : ℝ) (x : X n) : ℝ := (e u (x,t+h) - e u (x,t)) / h
noncomputable def major {n : ℕ} (R B : ℝ) : X n → ℝ := (box n R).indicator (fun _ => B)
def geometry {n m : ℕ} (u : X n × ℝ → Y m) (q : Y m) (τ : ℝ) (C : Set (X n)) (R : ℝ) : Prop :=
  IsCompact C ∧ 0 < R ∧ C ⊆ openBox n R ∧ (∀ x, x ∉ C → ∀ r ∈ Set.Icc (τ/2) (3*τ/2), u (x,r) = q)
def localData {n m : ℕ} (u : X n × ℝ → Y m) (q : Y m) (τ : ℝ) (C : Set (X n)) (R : ℝ) : Prop :=
  geometry u q τ C R ∧ IsCompact (box n R) ∧ volume (box n R) = ENNReal.ofReal ((2*R)^n) ∧ volume (box n R) < ⊤ ∧
  (∀ x, x ∉ C → ∀ r ∈ Set.Ioo (τ/2) (3*τ/2), ∀ k : ℕ, 0 < k → iteratedFDeriv ℝ k u (x,r) = 0) ∧
  (∀ r ∈ Set.Ioo (τ/2) (3*τ/2), good C R (fun x => e u (x,r)) ∧ good C R (fun x => et u (x,r)) ∧ good C R (fun x => aTerm u (x,r)) ∧ ∀ j, good C R (fun x => bTerm u j (x,r)) ∧ good C R (fun x => cTerm u j (x,r)) ∧ good C R (fun x => divFlux u j (x,r)))
def supportAndRegularity {n m : ℕ} (u : X n × ℝ → Y m) (q : Y m) : Prop :=
  regular u ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → Integrable (fun x => e u (x,t))) ∧ ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → ∃ C R, localData u q τ C R
noncomputable def fluxData {n m : ℕ} (u : X n × ℝ → Y m) (q : Y m) (t : ℝ) (j : Fin n) (C : Set (X n)) (R : ℝ) : Prop :=
  localData u q t C R ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => flux u j (x,t)) ∧ good C R (fun x => flux u j (x,t)) ∧
  (∀ x, divFlux u j (x,t) = bTerm u j (x,t) + cTerm u j (x,t))
end WM
